name: Obed
overview: The Scripture presents Obed as a significant figure in the lineage of David, highlighting his role as the son of Boaz and the father of Jesse, thereby establishing him as David's grandfather. This genealogy, detailed in Ruth 4:17-22, emphasizes the providential unfolding of God's plan through Obed's family line. Through this lineage, God's faithfulness in preserving the covenant promises is clearly demonstrated, underscoring Obed's place within the Messianic heritage.
